text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a car. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects within an image. These technologies have many useful applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to recognize traffic signs, detect pedestrians, and avoid accidents. Doctors also use it to examine medical images. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more important in our world.
